Mails.Title: Welcome to Selena-port
Mails.Content: Hello Commandant! Welcome to Selena-port, a local server built on the free AscNet software by its own authors. The server is their work; this build only carries it. Everything here is free. If anyone charges you for access to it, you are being scammed. Grants, mails and builds are managed from the control panel that came with this server, not from this screen. Enjoy the concert.
